_note: Real incident history. Add an entry when something goes wrong: impact = minor | major | critical | maintenance; times in UTC.

incidents.title: Server lost its network overnight
updates: The Mosaic server dropped off the network: sign-in, the Studio and the API stopped answering.
Confirmed the server was running but unreachable from the internet and the local network.
Restarted the server; everything came back and answers normally again.

incidents.title: Server restart; public address slow to come back
updates: The server restarted. It came back within minutes, but its public address stayed unreachable.
The public address was re-published and the API answers again.
